narrative.intro: PanTeXas Deterrence obligated $1.6B in federal contract funding in FY2026 to date. PanTeXas Deterrence received 1 award with an average award size of $1.6B. Current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date activity. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. The FY25 total of $1.9B and the FY26 to-date total of $1.6B dominate the recent record. The single large award drives the average award size and the current-year obligations total. Readers should note that the presented totals are fiscal year to date and therefore incomplete for FY2026, and that award-count and average-award-size reflect awarded value rather than annual run rate.
